participation.context: Paid the penny, doubted the size of the fleet, and answered the sailor.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave the news, named forty ships and the Queen's blessing, and cited the salt-beef barges.
participation.name: Davy Gannet

story.body: You took the news at the stair with the penny. You believed the salt beef, you did not count the fleet, and you did not get a rain.

title: Paid a penny and heard forty ships

participation.context: Refused a tally, named the forty ships, and said he was not in the Knave.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed civil and offered no addition to be written down.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Asked for a known door and refused to rehearse a thinner house a day early.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Kept the two stops, kept the new comedy off the afternoon plot, and sent the pass.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Held the songs and left Nick and Sam uncalled.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

story.body: You kept the morning civil, refused a column, and did not put yourself into the Knave. You carried Davy's number into the room and did not amend it.

participation.context: Named the short loaf and the uncounted ships, and stayed to listen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Charged sixpence and let the talk continue while doubt was still allowed.
participation.name: Alice Brambleby

participation.context: Said a man who knew the road would go quietly.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Asked, with great respect, why the gunner was in Bishopsgate.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You sat the sixpence supper and listened while the gold grew surer with the distance. You did not correct forty to another number. You did not leave before the talk turned.

title: Heard the chart at the Split Hazel

participation.context: Said he had doubted the count, and stayed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Put the man out, chart and all, and kept the sixpence supper.
participation.name: Alice Brambleby

participation.context: Distinguished a doubt from a sin.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Kept the respectful question, and let the man leave.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You stayed seated while Alice put the gunner out. You did not defend the chart, and you did not replace his number.

title: Saw the chart go out the door
